dialogues.speaker: Luzerne
dialogues.text: The insipid, the absurd, the shocking and the sorrowful... So long as you visit enough times, you will be able to experience all this at the Opera Epiclese.

dialogues.speaker: Luzerne
dialogues.text: Some people enjoy watching the emotions involved in real cases, while others prefer the interpretations and hype involved in theater productions.

dialogues.speaker: Luzerne
dialogues.text: Focalors, the Hydro Archon, recognizes them both as things that may be performed at the opera house.
